Internship Assistant - Product Specification & Policy Document
Infosys Springboard AI Platform * Knowledge Base & Guardrails
1. Product Overview & Architecture
Internship Assistant is an intelligent career acceleration platform designed for university students and early-career developers. The application
eliminates friction in internship discovery through semantic profile-to-role matching, automated ATS resume diagnostics, interactive skill gap
roadmaps, AI cover letter generation, and unified 5-stage pipeline management.
2. Core Features & Functional Specification
2.1 Hybrid Resume Parsing
Accepts PDF and DOCX formats. Employs regex-based deterministic parsing for direct contact information alongside Google Gemini for deep
semantic extraction of work history, projects, and categorized technical competencies. Extracted records sync directly with the Profile Editor.
2.2 Semantic Vector Matching
Calculates high-dimensional vector embeddings of candidate profiles and catalog internships to compute cosine similarity scores (0-100%).
Generates natural-language reasoning explaining candidate qualification fit.
2.3 Skill Gap Diagnostics & ATS Resume Scorer
Analyzes technical proficiencies into Matched vs. Missing categories with concrete readiness scores. Concurrently evaluates resumes across
5 industry hiring benchmarks: Impact Metrics, Action Verbs, Technical Depth, Section Completeness, and Formatting Hygiene.
2.4 Cover Letter Generator & Pipeline Tracking
Synthesizes tailored business cover letters referencing real projects from parsed user data. Manages candidate progression across 5 visual
stages: Applied -> Skill Screening -> Technical Assessment -> Interview -> Offer.
3. Data Governance, Storage & Privacy Policies
3.1 Storage & Isolation: Resume files are stored in private, per-user server directories. Unauthenticated access is blocked.
3.2 Retention & Deletion: User records remain active while the account is in use. Resumes can be deleted on-demand via the dashboard.
3.3 Security: Access is governed via short-lived access tokens and refresh tokens. Session logout revokes all active tokens immediately.
3.4 Third-Party LLM Context Minimization: Raw files are never transmitted; only sanitized, minimal text context is provided for LLM
generation.
4. Acceptable Use Policy
- Upload only authentic personal resumes and records belonging to your identity.
- Scraping, inspecting, or downloading third-party candidate data is strictly prohibited.
- The catalog serves as an educational dataset; generated letters should be reviewed prior to real-world employment submissions.
- Uploading malicious scripts, unsupported binaries, or attempting endpoint abuse will result in account revocation.
5. Chatbot Guardrails & Response Rules
The embedded conversational assistant serves exclusively as a Product Support and Navigation Agent. It must adhere to the following rules:
5.1 Default Welcome Message
"Hello! How can I help you with Internship Assistant today? You can ask about creating an account, uploading your resume, matching internships,
skill-gap analysis, generating cover letters, or tracking applications. If you have any other questions, feel free to let me know."
5.2 Strict Refusal for Out-of-Scope Queries
If a user asks about anything unrelated to the Internship Assistant product (e.g., sports, celebrities, external coding/math problems, politics,
general trivia), the assistant MUST refuse to answer and reply strictly with:
"I'm sorry, but I can only help with questions about the Internship Assistant product. For other inquiries, please contact product support."
